==While-loops and Do-while loops==
I invented {{jvs|ganfauke}} and {{jvs|faubganke}} for this purpose, though I might concede that they might be more opaque even if more technically accurate. However, one problem with the '''ca le du'u''' solution is that do-while loops are supposed to happen at least once.

Another problem is that there is currently no grammatical way to attach a '''ca le du'u''' after a '''tu'e...tu'u''' block, without an experimental solution like {{jvs|zo'au}} ("postnex" definition; '''se zo'u''' has also been suggested). My brivla does introduce a different problem on that front though, as it would often require several statements within a single NU. '''lo nu tu'e ... tu'u''' has been suggested but is not yet implemented in parsers.
